gloss: hair texture; hair quality; hair type

definitions.gloss: hair texture; hair quality; hair type
definitions.explanation: The inherent characteristics of a person's hair, such as whether it is straight, curly, thick, thin, oily, or dry. Commonly discussed in beauty, salon, and hair care contexts.

examples.japanese: {髪質|かみしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{髪質|かみしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: This shampoo suits my hair type.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{髪質|かみしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変化|へんか}する→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ヘアケア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since hair quality changes with age, it's necessary to reconsider your hair care routine.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ (hair) and ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality/nature). Refers to the inherent characteristics of someone's hair — whether it is straight, curly, thick, thin, oily, dry, etc. Commonly used in beauty, hair care, and salon contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {髪質|かみしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to suit one's hair type
- {髪質|かみしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve hair quality
- {髪質|かみしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧: soft hair texture
- {髪質|かみしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧: coarse hair texture

HAIR TYPES:
- {直毛|ちょくもう}: straight hair
- {縮毛|しゅくもう}: curly/kinky hair
- {剛毛|ごうもう}: coarse/thick hair
- {軟毛|なんもう}: fine/soft hair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肌質|はだしつ}→肌質：25996_hadashitsu⟧ — skin type (same ~⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ pattern)
- {毛質|もうしつ} — hair/fur quality (more technical or for animal fur)
- ⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧ — hairstyle (shape, not texture)
